pairs.target: dìshísìtiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi zài lù wù shì ménkǒu děng nài lěi , shǒulǐ niē zhe yìzhāng huà mǎn jiàntóu de zhǐ .
pairs.english: On the fourteenth afternoon Tavi waited for Nerai at the route collection, holding a sheet covered in arrows.
pairs.hanzi: 第十四天下午，塔维在路物室门口等奈蕾，手里捏着一张画满箭头的纸。

pairs.target: qiántiān tā chá guò kèbiǎo , quèrèn zhètiān xiūxi , yòu qù gōng fāng wèn néng bunéng dài liǎnggè tóngxué .
pairs.english: Two days earlier he'd checked the timetable, confirmed the rest day, and asked at the workshop if he could bring two classmates.
pairs.hanzi: 前天他查过课表，确认这天休息，又去工坊问能不能带两个同学。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō kěyǐ , jiào tāmen bié zài lǐmiàn chī dōngxī .
pairs.english: Nerai agreed, telling them not to eat inside.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说可以，叫他们别在里面吃东西。

pairs.target: mǐlā láide zuìzǎo , yīwén zuìhòu dào , zuǐlǐ háiyǒu méi yàn wán de bǐng .
pairs.english: Mira arrived first; Iven last, still chewing bread.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉来得最早，伊文最后到，嘴里还有没咽完的饼。

pairs.target: tā bèi mǐlā zhǐzhe liǎn kàn le bàntiān , cái zhuǎnshēn dào táijiē xià chī wán .
pairs.english: After Mira pointed and stared at his face a while, he turned and finished it below the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 他被米拉指着脸看了半天，才转身到台阶下吃完。

pairs.target: lù wù shì bú xiàng tǎ wéi xiǎng de nàyàng liàng .
pairs.english: The collection wasn't as bright as Tavi had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 路物室不像塔维想的那样亮。

pairs.target: chuāng kāi dé gāo , kàoqiáng de mùguì méng zhe báo huī , zhōngyāng yìzhāng dà zhuōshàng pù zhe qǐfú de shānxíng , hédào túchéng àn lán , jǐzuò shānfēng yǐjīng bèi rén mō dé diào le yánsè .
pairs.english: High windows overlooked dusty wooden cabinets; a big central table held rolling model mountains with dark-blue rivers, some peaks rubbed bare of paint.
pairs.hanzi: 窗开得高，靠墙的木柜蒙着薄灰，中央一张大桌上铺着起伏的山形，河道涂成暗蓝，几座山峰已经被人摸得掉了颜色。

pairs.target: shǒumén de lǎorén rènshi nài lěi , bǎ yàoshi dìgěi tā , wèn tā shàng huí jiè de cè gān zěnme shǎo le yígè tàotóu .
pairs.english: The elderly keeper knew Nerai. Handing her the key, he asked why the measuring rod she'd borrowed last time was missing an end cap.
pairs.hanzi: 守门的老人认识奈蕾，把钥匙递给她，问她上回借的测杆怎么少了一个套头。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zài xiū , lǎorén hēng le yìshēng , jiào tā xiūhǎo le zài jiè biéde .
pairs.english: Nerai said it was being repaired. He grunted and told her to finish that before borrowing anything else.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说在修，老人哼了一声，叫她修好了再借别的。

pairs.target: yīwén kànzhe tā shǒulǐ de bái pái , děng lǎorén zǒu yuǎn cái xiǎoshēng wèn , yuèjiè kè yě huì jiè búdào dōngxī ma .
pairs.english: Iven looked at the white tally in her hand, then waited till the keeper was away to ask quietly whether even Outriders could be refused a loan.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看着她手里的白牌，等老人走远才小声问，越界客也会借不到东西吗。

pairs.target: " yóuqí shì nòng diū guò dōngxī de . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Especially ones who've lost things,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “尤其是弄丢过东西的。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe tā zǒu dào dìyīpái guìzi .
pairs.english: Tavi followed her to the first row of cabinets.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着她走到第一排柜子。

pairs.target: lǐmiàn yǒu mùlún , duàn suǒ , chēzhóu , yě yǒu yìzhī biānyuán bǔguò hěn duōcì de fànhé .
pairs.english: Inside were wooden wheels, broken cables, axles, and a food tin with a repeatedly repaired rim.
pairs.hanzi: 里面有木轮、断索、车轴，也有一只边缘补过很多次的饭盒。

pairs.target: zhǐ qiān guà zài wùjiàn páng , shuōmíng cóng nǎlǐ lái , yònglái zuò shénme , yǒuxiē hái xiě zhe juānzèngrén de míngzì .
pairs.english: Paper labels beside them gave their origins and uses, some also naming donors.
pairs.hanzi: 纸签挂在物件旁，说明从哪里来，用来做什么，有些还写着捐赠人的名字。

pairs.target: nà zhī fànhé búshì cóng fèixū lǐ wāchūlái de .
pairs.english: The food tin hadn't been dug from ruins.
pairs.hanzi: 那只饭盒不是从废墟里挖出来的。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō juān tā de rén hái zài shānxià kāidiàn , xián jiù hégài bùyán , huàn le yígè dà de .
pairs.english: Nerai said its donor still kept a shop below the mountains; he'd replaced it with a larger one because the old lid wouldn't shut properly.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说捐它的人还在山下开店，嫌旧盒盖不严，换了一个大的。

pairs.target: yīwén fǔshēn kàn , fāxiàn gàizi shàng kè zhe liǎnggè rén fēn yìtiáo yú , dōu bùkěn fàngshǒu .
pairs.english: Iven bent closer and found two people carved on the lid, sharing a fish but neither letting go.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文俯身看，发现盖子上刻着两个人分一条鱼，都不肯放手。

pairs.target: " zhè rén hěn è . " tā shuō . " yě kěnéng nàtiáo yú hěn hǎochī . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “He's hungry,” he said. “Or the fish is delicious,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi:
“这人很饿。”他说。
“也可能那条鱼很好吃。”米拉说。

pairs.target: tāmen wǎng lǐ zǒu , yíliàng huòjī de pōumiàn móxíng fàngzài dī táishàng .
pairs.english: Farther in, a cutaway model of a freight machine stood on a low stand.
pairs.hanzi: 他们往里走，一辆货机的剖面模型放在低台上。

pairs.target: bànbiān wàiké chāi qù , lǐmiàn de zhóu lún , duǎn tī hé zhǎi tōngdào dōu lù zhe .
pairs.english: Half the casing was removed, exposing wheels and shafts, a short ladder, and narrow passages.
pairs.hanzi: 半边外壳拆去，里面的轴轮、短梯和窄通道都露着。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxiàlái , gé zhe mùlán kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched and looked through the wooden rail for a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下来，隔着木栏看了很久。

pairs.target: tōngdào jìntóu yǒu yíshàn xiǎomén , mén hòu shì kōng de , bú xiàng qiánmiàn jǐmǎn le lúnzǐ .
pairs.english: A small door stood at the passage's end, empty space behind it unlike the crowded wheels in front.
pairs.hanzi: 通道尽头有一扇小门，门后是空的，不像前面挤满了轮子。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ gěi nài lěi kàn , wèn nà jiān zuò shénme .
pairs.english: He pointed it out to Nerai and asked what that space was for.
pairs.hanzi: 他指给奈蕾看，问那间做什么。

pairs.target: " jiǎnxiū shí jìnqù . lǐmiàn yǒuxiē dìfāng , cóng wàitou gòu búdào . "
pairs.english: “You go in for repairs. Some places inside can't be reached from outside.”
pairs.hanzi: “检修时进去。里面有些地方，从外头够不到。”

pairs.target: " néng zuò gèrén ? "
pairs.english: “Could a person sit in it?”
pairs.hanzi: “能坐个人？”

pairs.target: " zhège móxíng zhào shíwù suōxiǎo guò , zhēn mén bǐ zhège dà . néng jìnqù , bùnéng dāng kècāng . xínghào yě bù yídìng gēn nǐ shuō de shì yìzhǒng . "
pairs.english: “The model's scaled down; the real door is bigger. You can get in, but it's no passenger cabin. And it may not be the kind you mentioned.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个模型照实物缩小过，真门比这个大。能进去，不能当客舱。型号也不一定跟你说的是一种。”

pairs.target: mǐlā yuánběn zài kàn lúnzhóu , tīngdào zuìhòu yíjù , táitóu kàn tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: Mira had been looking at the axle; at those last words she looked up at Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉原本在看轮轴，听到最后一句，抬头看塔维。

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu fàng xiàlái , zhǐjiān zài mùlán shàng cā le yíxià .
pairs.english: He lowered his hand, brushing his fingertips against the rail.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手放下来，指尖在木栏上擦了一下。

pairs.target: " tāmen shuō , wǒ shìcóng jiùhuò jī lǐ zhǎodào de . "
pairs.english: “They say I was found inside an old freight machine.”
pairs.hanzi: “他们说，我是从旧货机里找到的。”

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu xiàng tā xiǎng de nàyàng lìkè wèn fùmǔ .
pairs.english: Iven didn't immediately ask about his parents, as he'd expected.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有像他想的那样立刻问父母。

pairs.target: tā zǒu dào móxíng lìngyìtóu , cóng nàbiān wǎng lǐ kàn , xiǎng le xiǎng cái shuō : " nǎ zhǒng jiùhuò jī ? " " bù zhīdào . "
pairs.english: He went to the model's other end, peered in, and thought before asking, “What kind of old freight machine?” “I don't know.”
pairs.hanzi:
他走到模型另一头，从那边往里看，想了想才说：“哪种旧货机？”
“不知道。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō sè lā bǎ tā yǎng dà , xiǎoshíhòu de shì zìjǐ bú jìde .
pairs.english: Tavi said Sela had raised him; he didn't remember being little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说瑟拉把他养大，小时候的事自己不记得。

pairs.target: shuō dào zhèlǐ jiù tíng le , méiyǒu bǎ nàxiē tiánbiǎo , gàizhāng de shì dōu bānchūlái .
pairs.english: He stopped there without bringing up all the forms and stamps.
pairs.hanzi: 说到这里就停了，没有把那些填表、盖章的事都搬出来。

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn le kàn nà dào xiǎomén , yě méiyǒu zài zhuīwèn . " zhè tīzǐ zhēn nán pá . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Mira looked at the little door and asked nothing more. “That ladder looks hard to climb,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉看了看那道小门，也没有再追问。
“这梯子真难爬。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu . nà jǐjí tīzǐ quèshí zhǎi , fàngdà yǐhòu yě wèibì néng ràng rén hǎohǎo zhuǎnshēn .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded. Those rungs were narrow; even full-sized, they might leave little room to turn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头。那几级梯子确实窄，放大以后也未必能让人好好转身。

pairs.target: tā yòu kàn le yìyǎn , cái zhàn qǐlái , xīgài dūn dé yǒuxiē fāsuān .
pairs.english: He looked once more, then stood, knees aching from crouching.
pairs.hanzi: 他又看了一眼，才站起来，膝盖蹲得有些发酸。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu gěi móxíng bǔ shàng rènhé gùshì , zhī tì tāmen dǎkāi le hòumiàn de dìtú guì .
pairs.english: Nerai added no story to the model, simply opening the map cabinet behind it for them.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有给模型补上任何故事，只替他们打开了后面的地图柜。

pairs.target: zuì shàngmiàn yìzhāng tú yǐjīng pòsǔn , biānshàng niánzhuó yìquān bǐ yuán zhǐ xīn de chènzhǐ .
pairs.english: The top map was damaged, with a border of backing paper newer than the original.
pairs.hanzi: 最上面一张图已经破损，边上粘着一圈比原纸新的衬纸。

pairs.target: shānlù huà dé mì , wǎng xià yuèláiyuèshǎo , dào le yígè hēidiǎn jiù tíng le .
pairs.english: Mountain roads were densely drawn, thinning downward until they stopped at a black dot.
pairs.hanzi: 山路画得密，往下越来越少，到了一个黑点就停了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū , nà gēn tā zài huòzhàn jiàn guò de tú hěn xiàng .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized its resemblance to the freight-station map he'd seen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出，那跟他在货站见过的图很像。

pairs.target: " xiàmiàn méiyǒu le ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Nothing below that?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “下面没有了？”他问。

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng pángbiān chōuchū lìng yìzhāng , tān zài tóng yíkuài dìfāng .
pairs.english: Nerai pulled out another and spread it on the same spot.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从旁边抽出另一张，摊在同一块地方。

pairs.target: hēidiǎn yǐxià hūrán duōchū sāntiáo xìlù , háiyǒu xiǎoxiǎode wūdǐng hé yíchù huà chéng wān yèzi de shuǐtáng .
pairs.english: Below the dot now lay three thin routes, tiny roofs, and a pond drawn as a curved leaf.
pairs.hanzi: 黑点以下忽然多出三条细路，还有小小的屋顶和一处画成弯叶子的水塘。

pairs.target: " shàng yìzhāng zhī jì huò duì huànchē yǐqián zǒu de lù . zhè zhāng shì sòngyào de rén yòng de . "
pairs.english: “The first only records routes before the freight crews change vehicles. Medicine carriers use this one.”
pairs.hanzi: “上一张只记货队换车以前走的路。这张是送药的人用的。”

pairs.target: yīwén yòng zhǐtou bǐ zhe liǎng tú shàng de shān , fāxiàn dàxiǎo yě bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Iven compared mountains on both maps with his finger and found their scales differed too.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文用指头比着两图上的山，发现大小也不一样。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ tā shǒubiān de zhǐ jiǎo yāzhù , jiào tā bié ná yì zhǐ kuān dàngzuò yì lǐ .
pairs.english: Mira held down the corner by his hand and told him not to take a finger's width for a mile.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把他手边的纸角压住，叫他别拿一指宽当作一里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn de shì nàxiē wūdǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi was looking at the roofs.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看的是那些屋顶。

pairs.target: huà dé nàme xiǎo , què búshì suíshǒu diǎn de , yǒu de mén cháo shuǐtáng , yǒu de jǐ zài gāopō shàng .
pairs.english: Tiny as they were, they weren't casual dots: some doors faced the pond, some houses crowded a rise.
pairs.hanzi: 画得那么小，却不是随手点的，有的门朝水塘，有的挤在高坡上。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ nài lěi dài cuòguò de zhēn , yě xiǎngqǐ tā bǐjì lǐ nàtiáo bù chéngrèn shúrén de gǒu .
pairs.english: He remembered Nerai bringing the wrong needles, and the dog in her notebook that wouldn't recognize an acquaintance.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起奈蕾带错过的针，也想起她笔记里那条不承认熟人的狗。

pairs.target: " fànhé zhǔrén de diàn , yě zài zhèlǐ ? " " háiyào wǎng xī . nàge rén búhuì zài zhè zhāng tú shàng zhǎo zìjiā de mén . "
pairs.english: “The tin owner's shop is here too?” “Farther west. Its owner wouldn't look for his door on this map.”
pairs.hanzi:
“饭盒主人的店，也在这里？”
“还要往西。那个人不会在这张图上找自家的门。”

pairs.target: lǎorén huílái le , duān zhe yìwǎnshuǐ , shuō bié bǎ zhǐ tāndào zhuō wài qù .
pairs.english: The keeper returned with a bowl of water, telling them not to let the paper hang off the table.
pairs.hanzi: 老人回来了，端着一碗水，说别把纸摊到桌外去。

pairs.target: mǐlā liánmáng wǎng lǐ shōu , yīwén ràngchū dìfāng , sìgè rén de jiānbǎng jǐ dào yìqǐ . tǎ wéi méiyǒu juéde nánshòu .
pairs.english: Mira drew it in, Iven made space, and all four crowded shoulder to shoulder. Tavi didn't mind.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉连忙往里收，伊文让出地方，四个人的肩膀挤到一起。塔维没有觉得难受。

pairs.target: línzǒuqián , tā zài suíshēn nà zhāng fèizhǐ bèimiàn miáo le yígè wūdǐng , méiyǒu huà míngzì .
pairs.english: Before leaving, he sketched a roof on the back of his scrap paper, without a name.
pairs.hanzi: 临走前，他在随身那张废纸背面描了一个屋顶，没有画名字。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng děng zìjǐ rènde gèng duō zì , zài bǎ zhèlǐ de tú hǎohǎo kànyíbiàn .
pairs.english: He wanted to read these maps properly once he knew more characters.
pairs.hanzi: 他想等自己认得更多字，再把这里的图好好看一遍。

pairs.target: yīwén hái zài ménnèi gēn lǎorén wèn jiè tú de guījǔ .
pairs.english: Iven stayed inside asking the keeper about borrowing maps.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文还在门内跟老人问借图的规矩。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn zài táijiē shàng , tūrán wèn tǎ wéi , míngtiān nà liǎngzhī líng shìbushì dōu jiè dào le .
pairs.english: On the steps, Mira suddenly asked Tavi whether they'd borrowed both bells for tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站在台阶上，突然问塔维，明天那两只铃是不是都借到了。

pairs.target: " jiè dào le . mùchuí hái méi zhuāng . "
pairs.english: “Yes. The wooden strikers aren't fitted yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “借到了。木锤还没装。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ mùhé wǎng gēbo xià jiājǐn , shuō nà jiù huíqù .
pairs.english: She tucked her wooden box under her arm and said they'd better return, then.
pairs.hanzi: 她把木盒往胳膊下夹紧，说那就回去。

pairs.target: tāmen zǒuchū yíduàn , yī wéncái cóng hòumiàn zhuīshànglái , hǎn zhe děng tā , shǒulǐ shénme tú yě méi ná .
pairs.english: They'd gone some distance when Iven caught up, calling for them to wait, with no map in his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他们走出一段，伊文才从后面追上来，喊着等他，手里什么图也没拿。

pairs.target: " méi jiè dào ? " mǐlā wèn . " tā shuō xiān xuéhuì bǎ tújuàn huíqù . "
pairs.english: “Couldn't borrow one?” Mira asked. “He said I should learn to roll them up first.”
pairs.hanzi:
“没借到？”米拉问。
“他说先学会把图卷回去。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào nài lěi nàge bújiàn le de tàotóu , xiào le yíxià .
pairs.english: Thinking of Nerai's missing end cap, Tavi smiled.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想到奈蕾那个不见了的套头，笑了一下。

pairs.target: yīwén kànzhe tā , yòu kàn mǐlā , zuìhòu zìjǐ yě xiào le , shēnshǒu yào ná tǎ wéi nà zhāng mǎn shì jiàntóu de zhǐ .
pairs.english: Iven looked at him, then Mira, and finally laughed too, reaching for Tavi's arrow-covered paper.
